content:
ChartData published an interesting chart today, featuring Apple Music’s Top 20 most streamed artists of all time. Here is the list.

List also includes Bad Bunny, The Weeknd, and Eminem

In a post shared on X (via MacRumors) and reposted by Apple Music’s official account, ChartData revealed the platform’s 20 most-streamed artists of all time.

While Drake topped the list, Taylor Swift came in second, as the most-streamed female artist ever on the platform. Notably, a good portion of the list is composed of Rap and Hip-Hop artists.

Taylor Swift’s history with Apple Music goes back to before the platform’s launch, when the singer opposed Apple’s decision not to pay artists during its three-month free trial. Apple would later reverse the policy, prompting Swift to make 1989 available on the service.

Here’s the full list with Apple Music links to each artist

  • Drake
  • Taylor Swift
  • Future
  • YoungBoy Never Broke Again
  • Bad Bunny
  • Lil Baby
  • The Weeknd
  • Morgan Wallen
  • Kanye West
  • Post Malone
  • Travis Scott
  • Ariana Grande
  • Chris Brown
  • Kendrick Lamar
  • Lil Durk
  • Gunna
  • Rod Wave
  • Ed Sheeran
  • Justin Bieber
  • Eminem

Did your favorite artist make the list? Let us know in the comments.

Apple Music requires an active subscription. You can sign up for $10.99 per month, with 1 month free.
